reviews.text: Excellent dog training and sports facility

We left our Oliver behind because we were away for a few days on a business trip.
Oliver had a wonderful time, pampered and cared for. Despite the heat of the moment, he was always cool, with water toys available at all times. He played, made friends, and when we picked him up, he was very happy. We're very happy with the experience; we rarely leave Oliver alone because he always travels with us. But we had a great time here and were always kept up to date.
I recommend it without a doubt 🐶 🐾 ❤️
